task: capture quality: density-testable fraction, measured BEFORE the pipeline runs
why: big_house's mask is riddled with single-point cells, which is a capture shortfall and is permanent for that site because it cannot be re-flown. bungalow was flown by the same operator, so the same question has to be asked before anything is frozen on it.
comparability: raw-cloud figures are comparable only to other raw-cloud figures: a raw cloud mixes ground, vegetation and walls with the roof and their densities differ. Roof-only figures are comparable to other roof-only figures.

method.cell: 2.5 x median nearest-neighbour spacing, the pipeline's own grid rule, so the number means the same thing here as in the coverage report
method.testable: a cell holding at least 2 points
method.footprint: occupied cells with enclosed holes filled

measurements.subject: bungalow (raw cloud)
measurements.reading: points_per_occupied_cell p10 is the number that matters: the cell size is 2.5 x spacing, so a UNIFORM cloud would put several points in every occupied cell. A p10 of 1 means the sparsest tenth of the surface cannot be tested at all.
